trap.label: explain me
trap.wrong: The speaker explained me the process.
trap.right: The speaker explained the process to me.
trap.why: Em português "explicou-me". Em inglês, explain pede to antes da pessoa.

fix.wrong: The result depends of the sample.
fix.right: The result depends on the sample.

fix.wrong: In my point of view, it is fair.
fix.right: In my view, it is fair.

rewrite.prompt: Reescreva com however: “It is cheap but poor.”
rewrite.answer: It is cheap; however, it is poor.

rewrite.prompt: Reescreva no passado: “Sales fall in June.”
Reescreva com the author argues that: “It's unfair.” (author)
rewrite.answer: The author argues that it is unfair.
